name: hurricast-api
description: AWS backend for thegoldenhurricast.com: merch catalog, inventory, Stripe checkout and fulfillment, listener questions

scripts.deploy:dev: npm run check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run verify:bundle && serverless deploy --stage dev --package .serverless-package/dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run check && npm run lint && npm test && serverless package --stage prod --package .serverless-package/prod && node scripts/verify-bundle.ts .serverless-package/prod && serverless deploy --stage prod --package .serverless-package/prod
